entries.clue: Machine-whipped cone filler that coils from a nozzle in airy loops

Portly deliverer of standing stones who fell into the magic brew as a baby
Butterfly whose four staring wing marks borrow the name of a showy Indian bird
Tall woolly-leaved spire of a plant, stripped bare by a spotted grey grub
Carved monolith the strongman sculpts, sells and delivers slung on his back
Small magnifying lens, French in name, for telling tiny moths apart
Crested Roman officer commanding one of the four fortified camps close by
Fine-meshed bag on a hooped pole, swept over grass to catch an insect
Tinny Greensleeves peals that empty every house on the street in seconds
